ctbids-48286-5620858.description:
Vintage 14K Gold Italian Braided Herringbone Chain Bracelet.
The item shown is a vintage Italian braided herringbone chain bracelet. It features an intricate multi-strand woven flat design and is stamped with "ITALY" on its heart-shaped structural end tab, which connects the main chain to the lobster claw clasp.
These classic bracelets were highly popular imports from Italian jewelry manufacturers throughout the late 20th century. While some variations are made of solid 14K or 18K yellow gold, many similar vintage pieces were crafted from 925 sterling silver plated in gold (vermeil).
The heart-shaped end tab features a clear hallmark consisting of "14K" enclosed inside a diamond-shaped border. This tells you two important things:
Gold Purity: The "14K" stamp indicates that the metal is 58.3% pure gold mixed with alloy metals for strength and durability, which is the standard hallmark for fine jewelry in the United States.
Maker's Mark: The diamond outline serves as the manufacturer's trademark or maker's mark, indicating the specific Italian workshop that produced the piece for export.

Cross
Century Classic - Chrome Silver-Tone
Vintage, 2 Piece Set with Presentation Box
This classic Cross Century writing set includes a matched ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil, exemplifying the sleek, minimalist design that defined professional stationary in the late 20th century. Established in 1846, the A.T. Cross Company is renowned for its iconic conical top and pinstripe barrel textures. This set features the high-polish chrome finish with a vertical engine-turned line pattern, offering a timeless aesthetic and balanced writing weight.
Verified "CROSS USA" stamp on the cap of each piece
Classic Century pinstripe design with iconic black conical tops
Set includes: 1 twist-action ballpoint pen and 1 twist-action mechanical pencil
Original green and gold presentation box included
